title: Svalbard Treaty
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Svalbard Treaty", at revision 1372436106, opens: "The Svalbard Treaty recognises the sovereignty of Norway over the Arctic archipelago of Svalbard, at the time called Spitsbergen. The exercise of sovereignty is, however, subject to certain stipulations, and not all Norwegian law applies. The treaty restricts military uses of the archipelago, but it is not demilitarized." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q461891, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "treaty recognising Norwegian sovereignty over the Arctic archipelago of Svalbard".
